prompt: What is the time limit to complain to a labour officer about summary dismissal in Uganda?

sources.title: Employment Act — Section 69
sources.text: (1) Where an employee complains that he or she has been summarily dismissed without justification, he or she may, within six months after the date of dismissal, present a complaint to a labour officer who shall seek to settle the matter in the first instance by mediation.

prompt: When may an employer summarily dismiss an employee without notice?

sources.title: Employment Act — Section 68
sources.text: (1) An employer may summarily dismiss an employee where the conduct of the employee constitutes a fundamental breach of his or her obligations under the contract of employment. (2) Summary dismissal shall occur where an employer dismisses an employee without notice or with less notice than the notice the employee is entitled to be given.

prompt: Who may lodge a caveat on a certificate of title under the Registration of Titles Act?

sources.title: Registration of Titles Act — Section 139
sources.text: Any beneficiary or other person claiming any estate or interest in land under the operation of this Act or in any lease or mortgage under any unregistered instrument or by devolution in law or otherwise may lodge a caveat with the Registrar.

prompt: What compensation is available for loss caused by breach of contract?

sources.title: Contracts Act — Section 61
sources.text: Where a contract is broken, the party who suffers by the breach is entitled to receive, from the party who breaks the contract, compensation for any loss or damage caused to him or her which naturally arose in the usual course of things from the breach.
